description: Create and assign a task within an existing complaint in ArkCase. A complaint titled 'FOIA Request - Superfund Site Contamination Records - Chicago IL' has been pre-created. Log in as arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com (password: ArkCase1234!). Navigate to the Complaints module in the left sidebar, find this complaint in the list, and open it. Scroll down to the Tasks section within the complaint detail. Click the '+' button to add a new task. Set the task title to 'Review and Redact Responsive Documents'. Assign the task to 'arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com'. Set the priority to 'High'. Save the task.
